title: Morning pocket journal: QBR prep + renewal nudges
body:
6/12 morning pocket journal - quick personal checklist and scratch notes

Top priorities (today)
- Finish slide bullets for Meridian Health QBR (10:30am draft to Riley).
- Ping legal re: AtlasApps PO extension (need dates + MSA clause id).
- Close NimbusRetail support loop (ticket #5543) before EOD — handoff doc to SRE if escalates.

Timed blocks
- 8:30–9:00: pull metrics for Meridian QBR (latency p50/p95, error rate, token cost delta last quarter). Console -> "per-route breakdown" -> export csv.
- 9:00–10:00: slide write + bullets, sync w/ Riley 10:15.
- 11:00–11:30: call w/ AtlasApps renewal champion (prep notes below).

Account quick notes / one-liners
- Meridian Health (QBR 6/16): wants clear ROI line. Need: top-3 features used, avg token spend per workflow, incidents last 90d. Ask: can product show deduped latency graph? (Note: add screenshot from observability).
- AtlasApps (renewal window 7/1): champion is Lina, procurement flagged invoice cadence. Legal needs to confirm auto-renew clause opt-out window. Plan: offer 3-month bridge PO if legal slow.
- NimbusRetail (support): ticket #5543 intermittent tail latency after 11k tokens. Repro steps in ticket, assigned to eng-sre but need customer-facing note: "we're tracking, next update in 3 hours".

Draft lines to copy/paste (short)
- To AtlasApps (pre-call): "Quick note — pulling your renewal timeline and options before our chat at 11. If procurement has a short window, we can propose a 3-month bridge PO; will share options in the call."
- To Meridian execs (QBR invite update): "Adding a short ROI slide showing cost per workflow and latency improvements after optimizations. Any other data you want highlighted?"
- NimbusRetail status: "Thanks — our SREs have a reproduction attempt in progress. We'll update by 2pm with root-cause hypothesis or workaround."

Data pulls / artifacts needed
- Meridian: export route-level latency (last 6 months), top 5 prompts by volume, token spend by model. (Console -> Reports -> Export).
- AtlasApps: contract start/end dates, prior amendments (Confluence contract-folder).
- Nimbus: full debug logs for 6/11 03:00–04:00 UTC (ask eng on-call for logs link).

Open questions / parking lot
- Does "Dedicated" discount apply if customer moves 30% traffic to dedicated capacity? (Check pricing doc).
- Can we provide a one-page "health check" that shows cache hits and batching KPIs for QBRs? If not, quick hack: export cache metrics + a 1-paragraph explanation.

Micro-tasks (5–15m)
- Copy/paste Meridian bullet list into slide 3. [done? no]
- Add Lina's phone to AtlasApps contact list. [todo]
- Mark Nimbus ticket for escalation if no SRE update in 90m. [todo]
- Create calendar event for Meridian exec run-through 6/15 3pm (30m). [todo]

Notes to self (loose)
- Keep language simple for exec slide: "business outcome" + "engineering impact" + "next steps".
- Bring up cost control features during AtlasApps call: batching + quantization profiles — but don't dive deep unless they ask.
- If legal stalls on AtlasApps, loop in Samir from sales to nudge procurement.

Reminders before EOD
- Confirm Riley received slides and captured feedback.
- Send renewal options doc to Lina (AtlasApps).
- Follow up to SRE on Nimbus logs and update customer.

End-of-day quick review (template)
- What shipped? (slides, emails, tickets updated)
- What blocked? (legal, logs, missing data)
- Who to nudge tomorrow? (sales, legal, eng on-call)

Random brain dump (parking)
- Consider creating a short "renewal kit" checklist we can reuse: dates, champion, procurement contacts, current spend, trending, risk level, recommended ask. Could be a OnePager in Drive.

----
Version notes: started 2026-06-10, added quick copy lines and timeline on 2026-06-12.
